info.description: RAG-based question answering with streaming support. Failures use ErrorEnvelope with a stable code, safe message, advisory retryability and correlation_id. X-Correlation-ID identifies every application response. SSE execution failures use the same envelope in one terminal error event; HTTP 200 only opens the stream.

post.description:
Direct chat without knowledge base (streaming).

Returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) with:
- step: Reasoning step updates
- token: Streaming answer tokens
- complete: Final complete event
- error: Terminal ErrorEnvelope with the response's X-Correlation-ID

Accepts optional model_config_override to use custom LLM settings.

200.description: SSE connection opened. A terminal complete event indicates success; a terminal error event carries ErrorEnvelope. No complete event follows an error.
